name: Laksamana Khoja Husain
role: Admiral in the Annals’ purge account
bio: The admiral is one of the people through whom a merchant’s allegation reaches Mahmud. Later naval dispatches need not have come from the same man.
notes: fact: Brown names Khoja Husain and records punishment and his later death; Cortesão’s note prints Khoja Hasan (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 162–164, 171; Pires II, p. 256 n. 1)
inference: The unnamed Lingga admiral is not securely identifiable as Khoja Husain (Birch III, pp. 128–130; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: His position here indexes the purge episode, not leadership of a commercial faction (people-factions.md §3)
